action.contents:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mountpoint -q /boot/efi || { echo 'Borea Limine ESP is not mounted at /boot/efi' >&2; exit 1; }
for file in vmlinuz-linux initramfs-linux.img initramfs-linux-fallback.img; do
    test -s "/boot/$file"
    install -m 0644 "/boot/$file" "/boot/efi/$file"
done
